padding_rule: index clamping: the window at position p is max(0, p-w+1+j) for j=0..w-1, so a prefix shorter than the window repeats its earliest state. counts.npy records how many of the w slots are distinct, and every pooling operator that averages uses only those.
note: Wall time is recorded but is not the cost unit (pilot_report.md §11.7). Every probe point and every window size comes from one forward pass.
